Package aor.proj3t.dto

Class EvaluationDTO

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.dto.EvaluationDTO
public class EvaluationDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object for
invalid reference 
Evaluation
entity.

Represents a single evaluation record within a cycle, capturing score, feedback, timestamps, and references to participating users. Used primarily in API exchanges and service layer communication. Annotated for XML marshalling via JAXB.

Attributes: - id: Unique identifier for the evaluation - scale: Rating scale selected during the evaluation - status: Current state of the evaluation (e.g. PENDING, SUBMITTED) - feedback: Optional textual commentary provided by the evaluator - createdAt: When the evaluation was initially created - editedAt: Last time the evaluation was modified - evaluationCycle: Reference to the parent cycle this evaluation belongs to - evaluatee: User being evaluated (lightweight DTO) - evaluator: User performing the evaluation (lightweight DTO) JAXB-friendly for XML-based API compatibility. Example usage: 

     EvaluationDTO dto = new EvaluationDTO();
     dto.setScale(EvaluationScale.EXCELLENT);
     dto.setStatus(EvaluationStatus.SUBMITTED);
